shortDescription: Morningstar analyst David Swartz said the situation for sportswear stocks is unlikely to improve until late 2027. "Why Are Sportswear Stocks in a Rut? — WSJ," at 1:15 p.m. ET on Sept. 23, incorrectly attributed the comments to JD Sports Chief Executive Regis Schultz.
